title: Q10
description:
Read: Num 15:27-31, Deu 17:2-7

Unintentional sin has an offering. Sin with a high hand has none, and the soul is cut off. Going after other gods is death on two or three witnesses.

a) Wilful sin after receiving the knowledge of the truth, with no sacrifice left: which of these cases is it, and what does "no sacrifice" mean if the one offering has already been made?
